description: A falling-block puzzle with solo high scores and a fair 2 to 4 player versus mode. Everyone gets the same pieces, cleared lines send garbage rows to rivals, and the last one standing wins. Plays on phone, tablet, desktop and TV, with in-room voice and video and a leaderboard.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. neon-arcade block drop, a calm pastel theme, a retro green-CRT look
ui.description: Falling-block puzzle — solo + 2-4 player Versus with garbage. Responsive (phone → TV), voice/video, leaderboard.

sample_prompts: A neon arcade block drop with glowing pieces on a dark grid
A calming pastel block puzzle with soft colors
A retro green-CRT monochrome falling-block game
